Container.Name: steam-wayland
Container.Overview: Wayland-first headless Steam and UMU desktop streamed through Sunshine/Moonlight.

Config.Name: Persistent configuration
Config.Description: Sunshine credentials, Steam home, launcher state, and user Flatpaks.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: Persistent Steam, UMU, and direct-game storage.

Config.Name: DRI devices
Config.Description: DRM render devices.

Config.Name: Input devices
Config.Description: Input devices, including Sunshine virtual keyboard and mouse events, for Labwc/libinput.

Config.Name: uinput
Config.Description: Sunshine virtual input device.

Config.Name: FUSE
Config.Description: JC141/DwarFS/FUSE support.

Config.Name: udev database
Config.Description: Host udev metadata required for Labwc/libinput to discover hot-plugged virtual input devices.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Runtime user ID.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Runtime primary group ID.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPUs
Config.Description: Both RTX 3070 UUIDs, primary first, for NVIDIA 595 NVENC compatibility.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA runtime-injected driver capabilities.

Config.Name: Render node
Config.Description: Primary Vulkan render and NVENC adapter node.

Config.Name: wlroots renderer
Config.Description: Renderer selection. auto uses GLES2 for NVIDIA compatibility and wlroots automatic selection elsewhere; vulkan, gles2, or pixman may be set explicitly.

Config.Name: Allow empty libinput
Config.Description: Allow headless Labwc to start before Sunshine creates virtual input devices; set to 0 only when input nodes exist at startup.

Config.Name: Wayland seat
Config.Description: Seat assigned to Labwc and Sunshine virtual input.

Config.Name: Desktop mode
Config.Description: Fixed headless desktop resolution and refresh rate.

Config.Name: Mode policy
Config.Description: Use client to follow each Moonlight client's requested resolution and frame rate, or fixed to force DEFAULT_MODE.

Config.Name: XFCE GTK theme
Config.Description: GTK theme applied to the XFCE shell.

Config.Name: XFCE icon theme
Config.Description: Icon theme applied to the XFCE shell.

Config.Name: Sunshine CSRF origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated trusted Web UI origins, including scheme and optional port.

Config.Name: Enable Flatpak
Config.Description: Enable the container-local procfs workaround and persistent user Flathub.
